scope: One read-only parse of the current Nasdaq Trader Nasdaq-listed and other-listed text directories. Rows flagged as test issues or ETFs are excluded by the production parser. This checks exchange issue-name classification only; it is not a full market universe, rights, SEC CIK-join, or production-health audit.
limitations: A security description without explicit type wording remains unknown; the company's legal name is never used to infer common stock.
ADR rows remain research-only until the depositary ratio is proven for per-share valuation.
A live directory retrieval timestamp is not a rights grant. Display/redistribution terms still need confirmation.
The SEC ticker-to-CIK join is omitted from this count-only verification. Current official file rows and this parser result are not a completeness guarantee for every US exchange or security history.
